description: extremal-number compactness and degeneracy conjectures. separate bipartite constructions disprove the corrected erdos-simonovits compactness conjecture and erdos's r-degenerate graph bound, resolving erdos problems 180 and 146 as one bounded chapter portfolio. counterexamples. generated by astra, prepared as a manuscript by humans, and released with a lean certificate.

prior_rationale: Erdos posed the degeneracy conjecture in 1967, while Erdos and Simonovits stated the compactness conjecture in 1982; the chapter targets the corrected cyclic-family form of the latter.
advance_rationale: The two constructions completely disprove both universal conjectures in their intended nontrivial forms.
scope_rationale: Both counterexamples are asymptotic constructions valid for all sufficiently large graph orders, and the chapter treats the two related targets as one bounded portfolio.
resistance_rationale: Multiple independent partial theorems for degenerate bipartite graphs and compactness-type host-graph questions, including work across several graph classes, document resistance on both targets.
age_rationale: The bundled portfolio contains targets from 1967 and 1982; recording its earliest exact framing gives 59 years or 5.9 decades to the 2026 resolution, and both components independently exceed the one-decade threshold.
